notes.title: We will release the EA version on April 23rd
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093891/8d3be6ce214d6fafb481adaf7598c288d4ef12bb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093891/cf4ce735bf79485f370193d57552bb7bd363b0fa.jpg[/img][/url]
In order to better improve the game. Collect player opinions and feedback, continuously improve and fix the game quickly, and make the game better.

The early access status is expected to last for about six months.

The current early access version already includes a complete game mode, including planting, logging, fishing, mining, building, pet raising, pet assignment, battles, etc. It already contains more than 90 types of supplies, 10 types of buildings, 20 types of pets, 10 types of manufactured items, 40 types of food, etc. It includes various ordinary plots, missions, weather, sea islands, etc. It also includes pirate battles, plant mutations to fight pirates, hunting wild animals, using and upgrading tools and weapons, etc.
